notes.title: More bugs squashed
notes.content:
Hey everybirdie,

You have probably noticed a few game updates over the last few days, these were to try and fix some of the remaining issues people have been having. These issues in particular:


    Achievements sometimes not unlocking.
    Graphical glitch in chapter 4.
    Issues with progress sometimes not reloading.
    Black screen startup/new game issue.


We believe this latest release will fix the above issues. However if you are still having any problems please continue to report on them in the forums.

Thanks ːheartofulː

notes.title: A Holiday Star update is now live
notes.content:
Hey everybirdie,

Thanks so far for the great reception to the release of Hatoful Boyfriend: Holiday Star, everyone appreciates this greatly ːheartofulː

We are aware there has been a few issues with the launch build and have been working to get as many of these as possible fixed as quickly as we can. Today we rolled out the following fixes:


Windowed mode/resolution options re-enabled via launcher.
Soundtrack issues resolved, now you can enjoy the full magic of Holiday Star!
Various typos fixed.
Linux: Missing library added.
Added more soundtracks to Collector's Edition content.
Various other small fixes.


We will continue to monitor the forums for issues and try and fix things up where we can.

Happy Holidays ːHBhohohoː

Mediatonic
